sql_query:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS day,
  ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-12-01' AS DATE)
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
